mentions.name: Webvetted
mentions.description: An AI private investigator platform that automates data gathering using open source intelligence (OSINT) and correlates the findings. It is used by over 70k investigators, including government agencies.
mentions.problem: OSINT data gathering and correlation is hard, labor-intensive work that investigators otherwise do manually.
mentions.source_excerpt: It’s an AI Private Investigator that does the hard work of data gathering (using Open Source Intelligence) and correlation. Used by over 70k investigators including government agencies.
